name: HR Leave Policy Example
description: Three HR leave questions for learning the six metrics. Run it with the uploaded results file leave_example_results.json: Q1 (annual leave) gives Precision@5 40%, Recall@5 66.7%, F1 50% and NDCG@5 0.704; over the three questions Hit Rate@5 is 2/3 and MRR is (1 + 0.5 + 0) / 3 = 0.50. Q3 (maternity leave) gets five wrong chunks, to show what a complete retrieval failure looks like.

chunks.title: Annual leave entitlement
chunks.text: Employees receive 20 annual leave days each calendar year. Annual leave is paid at the normal salary rate.

chunks.title: Annual leave approval
chunks.text: Annual leave requires manager approval. Submit the annual leave request in the HR portal at least one week before the first day of leave.

chunks.title: Annual leave carry-forward
chunks.text: Unused annual leave can be carried forward to the next year, up to a maximum of 10 days. Days above the limit lapse on 31 March.

chunks.title: Salary details
chunks.text: Salaries are paid on the last working day of each month. The payslip shows basic pay, allowances and tax deductions.

chunks.title: Attendance policy
chunks.text: Employees mark attendance in the HR portal every working day. Three late arrivals in a month count as half a day of absence.

chunks.title: Employee benefits
chunks.text: Employee benefits include meal vouchers, a gym membership and a yearly learning budget for courses and books.

chunks.title: Medical insurance
chunks.text: Group medical insurance covers employees, their spouse and two children for hospital expenses up to 5 lakh a year.

chunks.title: Office working hours
chunks.text: Office working hours are 9:30 to 18:00, Monday to Friday, with a one-hour lunch break.

chunks.title: Sick leave entitlement
chunks.text: Employees get 12 days of paid sick leave per year. Sick leave cannot be carried forward.

chunks.title: Sick leave certificate
chunks.text: Sick leave of more than two days in a row needs a medical certificate from a registered doctor.

chunks.title: Maternity leave duration
chunks.text: Eligible employees receive 26 weeks of paid maternity leave for each of their first two children.

chunks.title: Maternity leave eligibility
chunks.text: Maternity leave is available to employees who have worked for at least 80 days in the 12 months before the expected delivery date.
